title: A single exposure to altered auditory feedback causes observable sensorimotor adaptation in speech
reason: The paper pools/reanalyzes production data from six previous studies rather than collecting an independent primary recording set; admitting it as a source would double-count underlying participant recordings.
evidence: Methods describe a reanalysis of six previous studies totaling 131 participant records, with 40 individuals participating in two studies; public code/data are useful for lineage and derived-analysis reproduction but not as a new primary recording source.
lineage_action: Retain publication as a secondary-analysis lineage reference; link its component studies when individually eligible instead of ingesting pooled rows as new observations.
